title: A New Generalization of the Topp-Leone-G Distribution Family with Applications
content: A new family of  probability distributions, the new generalized Topp-Leone-G (NGTL-G) model,  is obtained. This family may be regarded as an extension  of the Topp-Leone-G family, an extra parameter β is added.       Mathematical properties of the new family are studied using analytical, graphical, and numerical approaches.  In particular, moments and the quantile function are researched.  Besides,  stochastic ordering results and order statistics are discussed.   A particular member of the NGTL-G family, the NGTL-Weibull (NGTL-W) distribution is given special attention.   The quantile function, the Bowley's skewness, and the Moors' kurtosis of the NGTL-W model are studied.  Results on stochastic ordering and distribution of order statistics are obtained.   Sufficient flexibility of the NGTL-W model is demonstrated by fitting this family to several real data sets and comparing fits to those of competing distributions.
